notes.title: Global graphics update - in development!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38280149/fb2450d7c40d3aa8091f162a099efd07ad95e938.jpg[/img]

Today, I'm excited to announce that I’ve recently started working on a major update for Painted Legend 2! I plan to overhaul and enhance all graphics and animations in the game, just like I did a year ago with the first part!

Perhaps the most noticeable change, which you might have already seen in the screenshot, is the new art style. The game will now fully adopt the style of the first part and the sequel, Knights of Ink & Paper. I’ve been thinking about this idea for a long time and finally decided to bring it to life! But if you prefer the original style, which is more reminiscent of 80s cartoons, don’t worry—the game will still include an option to play with the previous graphics and animations!

Additionally, the update will introduce more decorative elements and a revamped interface with a redesigned main menu. The update will be completely free for all current and future owners of the game!

Thank you for your attention :)
